title: RTEC organizational structure snapshots - 2025 and early 2026
summary: Dated organizational snapshots showing RTEC leadership, administrative, HSTD, fleet/facilities, operations, dispatch/data-entry, custodial and transportation-staffing structures. The 2026 chart was revised 2025-12-30 and later 2026 evidence shows at least the EEO-role holder changed during the year.

claims.claim: Both 2025 and early-2026 charts place the Board of Directors above the Executive Director/CEO and show HSTD, Fleet & Facilities, Operations and transportation-support branches below central management.
The 2025 chart lists a Deputy Director/Procurement Manager position under the Executive Director, while the 2026 chart instead shows an HR & EEO Manager in that upper-left management position.

The early-2026 chart names Clarissa Hodge as HR & EEO Manager, while the later EEO policy signed 2026-08-26 names Jacob Salsman as EEO Manager/EEO Officer, indicating a later change in the EEO role-holder or role allocation.

controls: Treat org charts as dated snapshots; never infer current reporting lines from an old chart without later evidence.
unresolved_questions: Is there a revised organization chart after 2026-08-26?
Did the HR Manager and EEO Officer responsibilities split into separate roles later in 2026?
Which roles shown in the early-2026 chart have changed since revision 12/30/2025?
automation_candidates: Maintain effective-dated role/reporting relationships so organizational changes do not overwrite historical process ownership.

provenance.notes: Early-2026 snapshot; later 2026 EEO evidence shows at least one role-holder change.
